headline: EPS roughly flat q/q, up year-over-year
summary_short: Sumitomo reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ¥39.95, roughly flat q/q (-0.4%) and up 13.2% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of ¥39.95 was little changed sequentially (-0.4%) from ¥40.09 and rose 13.2% year-over-year from ¥35.30. This is the only comparable KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
